turns.userMessage:
Build a detailed Taj Mahal: a wide raised platform, a central hall with a great arched iwan on each face, a large central onion dome on a drum, four smaller domed kiosks around it, and four slender corner minarets with little domes. All white with subtle accents. 450-900 parts.
Constraints: footprint must fit within 36x36 studs; height at least 360 LDU (15 bricks); use at least 400 parts.
